result:
Both gaps are closed: the New transformation screen now shows the mode guidance verbatim, and the Team tab is built. All required checks pass except the repo-wide `pnpm format:check`, which this sandbox blocked (explained in the checks below). The changes are uncommitted in `apps/web/**`, plus the handback at `docs/delivery/handbacks/DG2/T-DG2-FE2-frontend-ux-engineer.md`.

**REQ-PB-003: mode guidance on New transformation**
- Each mode option shows its "When to use" line. A panel below shows the selected mode's "When to use" and "How", and changes when the mode changes.
- The English text matches the playbook table exactly. The unit test compares it character by character against `docs/source/playbook.md`, so any drift fails.
  - End-to-End: "Run Phases 1-6 sequentially. Do not launch initiatives before the North Star, outcomes and target state are clear."
  - Modular: "Enter at the relevant phase, complete the minimum mandatory templates, then reconnect to outcomes and benefits."
- The table is anchored **B0009**, not B0008 as the assignment said, so the screen and tests cite B0009.
- Arabic shows a translation that the screen labels as provisional, with the exact English source on its own line beneath it. This means the e2e can check the exact source text in both languages.
- Choosing Modular without an entry phase marks the field as an error and sends nothing. A server error on the entry phase is also shown on that field.

**REQ-PB-012 / REQ-S10-008: Team tab**
- The six playbook governance roles appear in order, each with its accountability text (B0018 wording in English) and who holds it. Assignments made at this transformation are told apart from inherited ones.
- A role with nobody assigned says so in words, never a blank.
- Supporting roles (KPI/Data Steward, Tech/Data Contributor, committee roles) carry their platform text. The table of team members shows the accountability on each assignment and supports sort, filter, column choice and paging.
- Transformation Leads and the Transformation Office can assign only the roles the API accepts: Workstream Lead, KPI/Data Steward, Tech/Data Contributor, Committee Member and Committee Secretary. The other roles are marked as assigned by an access administrator.
- The auditor sees the whole page read-only with no assign control. The server still refuses with a 403.

**Checks run (final state)**
- **Passed:** DG1 historical validator (before and after), typecheck, build, lint, and the contrast check.
- **Web unit tests:** 153 passed; 11 of them are new.
- **E2E against the real API and database:** 38 of 38 passed, 19 in English and 19 in Arabic. No accessibility violations were found on any new page.
- **`pnpm format:check` failed (exit 2) because of the sandbox:** prettier couldn't read some untracked files at the repo root that the sandbox blocks. Prettier passed on everything in `apps/web`, but the full check needs re-running outside the sandbox.
- **New text colour:** the "not assigned" warning colour isn't in the token contrast list, so I computed it by hand: 7.41:1, which meets AA.

I looked at the English and Arabic screenshots myself and fixed two problems before the final run. Workstream Lead was listed twice, and in Arabic the English source wrapped around its label. Screenshots are in `apps/web/e2e/screenshots/{en,ar}/` (`04b`/`04c-create-guidance-*`, `p2-17c`/`17d`/`17e-team*`, `p2-18-aud-team`). That folder is ignored by git, so they exist only locally and are regenerated by the e2e command.

**Gaps (also in the handback)**
- The Team screen can't assign Executive Sponsor, Business Owner, Finance, Lead, Office or Auditor; the API sends those through Administration > Assignments.
- A Lead without user-directory access can only pick people already on the team.
- There is no revoke or end-date control on this screen.
- Routing decisions to the mapped person belongs to a later gate (DG4) and isn't covered here.
- The Arabic texts still need review by a Mobily Arabic-language owner.

The old `transformations.form.modeHelp` translation keys were removed. Nothing else in the repo uses them, but another branch that still does would fail the i18n test.
